new_supporting_lemma.statement: With unnormalized ambiguity kernels K_j, difference masses q_j, weights theta_j, and finite mixed BL constant B_theta(A) for L_j u=(u_j,(Au)_j) at exponent theta_j/2 and P_j u=u_j at exponent 1-theta_j, |phi_A(t)|^2 <= B_theta(A) pi^(Theta/2)|t|^(-Theta/2). Theta>4 is sufficient for an L1 Fourier closure.

new_correction.statement: For A_m=[1] direct_sum J_m/m direct_sum (-J_m/m), every finite mixed ambiguity/section-mass BL datum forces theta_0=0 and bank ambiguity weights at most 2 each, hence Theta<=4. This absolute BL interpolation cannot give an integrable |phi| bound even on this target-valid exact-rank-three family.

positive_family_payment.statement: For the same A_m and arbitrary independent cap-one source laws, group each rank-one bank into Y_+=m^(-1/2)sum X_j and Y_-=m^(-1/2)sum X_j. Ball--Rogozin plus the beta convolution gives ||p_Q||_infinity<=pi sqrt(2), uniformly in m.

partner_applied.use: Used QFORM-UNNORMALIZED-AMBIGUITY-LP-v1 and exact decoupling as the primitive for the mixed BL lemma and bank obstruction.

Applied QFORM-PHYSICAL-TRIPLE-DETERMINANT-v1 to A_m: every invertible triple has determinant magnitude m^-2, yielding <105 m^(2/3), quantitatively worse than the grouped pi sqrt(2) bound and confirming aggregate-before-inversion is necessary.

next_open_bridge: QFORM-GROUPED-AMBIGUITY-BANK-BRIDGE-v1: control a bank-level unnormalized ambiguity/oscillatory object for a normalized original-coordinate product projection and synthesize grouped banks or a full-matrix exit under only three large eigenvalues, retaining arbitrary extra spectrum and never normalizing thin fibers.
